description: This file defines a class MessageReceiver that extends BroadcastReceiver to listen for broadcast intents, specifically for login account changes, and logs when such broadcasts are received.

classes.name: MessageReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for system broadcasts related to account changes and logs receipt of such broadcasts.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast intents and logs a message indicating receipt of the LOGIN_ACCOUNTS_CHANGED broadcast.
